pages.title: A rainy Sunday · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a rainy Sunday afternoon in a cozy bookstore in Seattle. Tall wooden shelves reach to the ceiling. The smell of old paper and coffee fills the room. Ana runs her fingers along the book spines. A bookseller named Mel carries a stack of novels. She stops and smiles at Ana.
“Hello! Are you looking for something special?” says Mel. “Yes. Last week I read a great mystery.” says Ana. “Oh nice! What was it called?” says Mel.
